claims.text: The hotel is in Sao Paulo's business district, close to many restaurants, shopping centers and attractions.

findings.quote: Nestled in São Paulo’s vibrant business district, our centrally located luxury hotel puts you close to many top restaurants, shopping centers and attractions.
findings.note: Official page confirms the business-district location and proximity to restaurants, shopping centers and attractions.

claims.text: The hotel is convenient to corporate offices in the business-heavy Berrini area.

findings.quote: Convenient to corporate offices in the business-heavy Berrini area, this mega hotel is purpose-built for groups, events, and the briefcase-toting traveler.
findings.note: Condé Nast Traveler states this directly.

claims.text: A metro station is a short walk from the hotel.

findings.quote: Taxis or Ubers are necessary here, but the metro station is a short walk away.
findings.note: Confirms the metro station is a short walk away.

claims.text: Guests enter through a sunshine-filled marble lobby.

findings.quote: The moment you enter the sunshine-filled marble lobby, it becomes clear that this hotel is true to its name.
findings.note: Describes the sunshine-filled marble lobby.

claims.text: Rooms have Granado bath amenities.

findings.quote: Granado bath amenities
findings.note: Listed among in-room amenities for every room type.

findings.quote: Bathrooms stock Brazilian-made Granado toiletry products.
findings.note: Editorial review confirms Granado products.

claims.text: The 2 Bedroom Residence offers panoramic views of the Estaiada Bridge, expansive windows, a kitchen, a dining area and a living area.

findings.quote: Enjoy panoramic views of the iconic Estaiada Bridge from this 140-square-meter residence offering expansive windows, a kitchen, a dining area and a living area.
findings.note: Every listed feature of the 2 Bedroom Residence is confirmed.

claims.text: Amanary Spa offers facials, massages and body treatments.

findings.quote: Choose from a variety of soothing facials, therapeutic massages and invigorating body treatments to relax the mind and body.
findings.note: Amanary Spa section lists facials, massages and body treatments.

claims.text: The fitness center has Technogym equipment and offers boxing and yoga classes and personal trainers.

findings.quote: Keep up your fitness routine with Technogym equipment, boxing and yoga classes, complemented by a sauna and climatized indoor pool.
findings.note: Confirms the Technogym equipment and the boxing and yoga classes.

findings.quote: The fitness center also offers personal trainers, free parking and special discounts at the hotel’s restaurants and spa.
findings.note: Confirms personal trainers.

claims.text: Cittadino is the signature restaurant, serving contemporary Italian cuisine with fresh pasta prepared daily.

findings.quote: Visit our São Paulo hotel’s signature Cittadino Restaurant, which celebrates contemporary Italian cuisine with fresh pasta prepared daily, bringing authenticity and flavor to every dish.
findings.note: Dining page confirms every element.

claims.text: The pool is heated with steam exhaust, and recycling and food-waste reduction programs are in place.

findings.quote: The pool is heated with steam exhaust, and recycling and food-waste reduction programs are in full swing.
findings.note: Eco effort section states this directly.

claims.text: The hotel is pet friendly, with a pet park that has toys and a green area.

findings.quote: Your canine companions are welcome at our pet-friendly São Paulo hotel. We provide a pet park with pet toys, a green area and ample space for your furry friends to run.
findings.note: Confirms the hotel is pet friendly and has a pet park with toys and a green area.

claims.text: Congonhas Airport is 6 kilometers from the hotel.

findings.quote: 6 Kilometers
findings.note: Listed directly under Congonhas Airport (CGH) in the Transportation section.

claims.text: The Diplomatic Suite is a corner suite with floor-to-ceiling windows, a separate dining area and panoramic views of the Ponte Estaiada bridge.

findings.quote: Spread out in an exclusive 109-square-meter corner suite with a plush king bed and floor-to-ceiling windows. Also enjoy a separate dining area and panoramic views of the Ponte Estaiada bridge.
findings.note: Every element of the Diplomatic Suite description is confirmed.

claims.text: Some rooms offer unobstructed views of Sao Paulo's Estaiada Bridge.

findings.quote: Take in unobstructed views of São Paulo’s famous Estaiada Bridge from this 37-square-meter room that features a plush queen bed, a dedicated workspace and a spacious closet.
findings.note: The 1 Queen Bed With Bridge View room offers unobstructed bridge views.

claims.text: The Grand Club Lounge is on the 20th floor, with high ceilings and city views, and offers club and suite guests complimentary continental breakfast, Wi-Fi, cocktails and appetizers.

findings.quote: Located on the 20th floor, our exclusive Grand Club Lounge provides comfort and convenience for guests in our club and suite categories.
findings.note: Confirms the 20th floor and that it serves club and suite guests.

findings.quote: Along with high ceilings and breathtaking city views, the lounge offers complimentary continental breakfast, Wi-Fi access, cocktails and appetizers.
findings.note: Confirms high ceilings, city views and the complimentary offerings.

claims.text: Amanary Spa has seven treatment rooms, a sauna, a climatized indoor pool and a cardio and strength studio.

findings.quote: Our São Paulo hotel spa facility features seven treatment rooms, a sauna, a climatized indoor pool and a cardio and strength studio.
findings.note: All spa facilities are confirmed.

claims.text: The climatized indoor and outdoor pool has bar service, and a series of waterfalls spill into it to cover traffic noise.

findings.quote: Enhance your experience in São Paulo with amenities like a climatized indoor and outdoor pool, plus bar service perfect for sunny days.
findings.note: Confirms the climatized indoor and outdoor pool with bar service.

findings.quote: Designers were clever enough to install a series of waterfalls that spill into the pool to cover up traffic noise from the pool’s location.
findings.note: Confirms the waterfalls that cover traffic noise.

claims.text: The area is not one where you can walk out the front door and explore interesting shops or cafes; taxis or Ubers are necessary.

findings.quote: This is not the kind of area where you can walk out the front door and explore interesting shops or cafes. Taxis or Ubers are necessary here, but the metro station is a short walk away.
findings.note: Editorial review states this directly.

findings.quote: Easy to walk to nearby restaurants and bars.
findings.note: A guest review describes the area as walkable to restaurants and bars.

claims.text: The hotel has an attached event center with 17 meeting rooms and event spaces and a grand ballroom, so expect conference and group business.

findings.quote: Discover 17 meeting rooms and event spaces with high ceilings and natural light, a grand ballroom that holds 1,200 attendees and extensive catering options at our dedicated event center attached to our São Paulo hotel.
findings.note: Confirms the attached event center with 17 meeting rooms and event spaces and a grand ballroom.

findings.quote: Convenient to corporate offices in the business-heavy Berrini area, this mega hotel is purpose-built for groups, events, and the briefcase-toting traveler.
findings.note: Supports the expectation of conference and group business.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning and Sao Paulo's cosmopolitan market.
